description: This file contains utility functions for handling batch processing, including calculating costs and usage, transforming responses, and managing file content for batch jobs in a machine learning context.

classes.name: Batch
classes.description: A data structure representing a batch job, including output file ID and response details.

classes.name: ModelResponse
classes.description: A placeholder class for handling model response data.

classes.name: Usage
classes.description: A data class representing token usage metrics including total, prompt, and completion tokens.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: A class used for logging batch processing activities, especially in Vertex AI context.

methods.name: calculate_batch_cost_and_usage
methods.description: Calculates the total cost and usage for a batch of files given the content and provider.

methods.name: _handle_completed_batch
methods.description: Processes a completed batch, retrieves output, and calculates cost and usage.

methods.name: _get_batch_models_from_file_content
methods.description: Extracts model names from batch file content.

methods.name: _batch_cost_calculator
methods.description: Calculates batch cost, with special handling for Vertex AI.

methods.name: calculate_vertex_ai_batch_cost_and_usage
methods.description: Calculates cost and usage from Vertex AI batch responses.

methods.name: _get_batch_output_file_content_as_dictionary
methods.description: Retrieves batch output file content as a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: _get_file_content_as_dictionary
methods.description: Parses bytes content into a list of JSON objects.

methods.name: _get_batch_job_cost_from_file_content
methods.description: Calculates total cost from batch file content.

methods.name: _get_batch_job_total_usage_from_file_content
methods.description: Calculates total token usage from batch file content.

methods.name: _get_batch_job_input_file_usage
methods.description: Counts tokens in input files for rate limiting.

methods.name: _get_batch_job_usage_from_response_body
methods.description: Extracts usage metrics from response body.

methods.name: _get_response_from_batch_job_output_file
methods.description: Extracts response data from batch output file.

methods.name: _batch_response_was_successful
methods.description: Checks if batch response status code is 200.
